words.gloss: those who have disliked or abandoned us

literal: The great dignity of not going after those who disliked us is not one thing known by those who suffer from the disease of love.
translation: The noble dignity of not running after those who have abandoned us is not something known to those who suffer from the affliction of love.
modern: நம்மை வெறுத்து நீங்கியவர் பின்னே செல்லாமல் இருக்கும் பெருந்தன்மை, காமநோயால் வருந்துபவர்கள் அறியக்கூடிய ஒன்று அல்ல.
explanation: This couplet describes the loss of self-control and dignity under the influence of intense love. Normally, self-respect demands that one should not pursue someone who has shown dislike or abandoned them. However, the speaker confesses that such noble restraint is impossible for those afflicted with the disease of love. Their overwhelming passion breaks all barriers of pride, forcing them to seek out the very person who caused them pain.
